description: This file defines the client-side component for a movie showtime booking page, including seat selection, payment processing placeholder, and booking confirmation flow.

methods.name: toggleSeat
methods.description: Toggles the selection status of a seat, ignoring seats that are already taken.

methods.name: handleBook
methods.description: Transitions the step state to 'payment' to proceed with the booking.

methods.name: handleConfirmPayment
methods.description: Simulates payment confirmation, then sets the step to 'complete' and redirects to the booking history.
